title: Cox regression with a time-varying exposure
summary: The hazard ratio for current exposure when exposure starts during follow-up, in counting-process (start, stop] form, avoiding immortal time bias.

sizing._why: Events under a time-varying exposure depend on when exposure starts; the log-rank form assumes fixed groups and would misstate the exposed person-time. Sizing is a simulation.

pinned_defaults: Both: the counting-process form, one row per person-period with the exposure current during it. Coding 'ever exposed' at baseline creates immortal time: on this fixture it gives a log hazard ratio of -1.61 against a true -0.51.
R: ties = 'efron' named (coxph's default); lifelines' CoxTimeVaryingFitter uses Efron.
